overview: AdaCache proposes an adaptive caching and context augmentation framework for efficient RAG-based LLM serving, combining cache-aware selective recomputation with hierarchical KV caching and adaptive context augmentation driven by lightweight confidence estimation to reduce TTFT while preserving generation quality.

modules.name: Attention Pattern Profiler
modules.description: Analyze chunk-level attention distributions across all transformer layers to identify localized attention patterns in early layers and attention sink phenomena in deeper layers; aggregate per-layer attention weights to chunk granularity and visualize the resulting attention heatmaps for diagnostic insight.

modules.name: Hierarchical KV Cache Manager
modules.description: Implement the three-tier cache storage architecture—Hard Prefix Cache (exact prefix matching with full KV storage along matched path), Soft Prefix Cache (effective prefix matching using attention-sink or predecessor chunks as cache keys with partial KV storage), and Independent Cache (chunk-level matching without prefix dependencies)—with hash-based key lookup and hierarchical query ordering.

modules.name: Cross-Chunk Attention Token Selector
modules.description: Identify tokens with the highest cross-chunk attention ratios from the first layer's attention matrix, leveraging the observed layer-wise consistency of KV deviation sparsity; output the ordered set of recomputation candidate tokens that will be uniformly applied across all subsequent layers.

modules.name: Cache-Aware Selective Recomputation Engine
modules.description: Orchestrate the recomputation strategy by first querying the hard prefix cache for exact matches (direct reuse, no recomputation), then the soft prefix cache for effective prefix matches (recomputation ratio α), and finally the independent cache (recomputation ratio β > α); apply the token selector to determine which token KV states are recomputed versus reused from cache for each matched tier.

modules.name: Confidence Estimator
modules.description: Compute the composite confidence metric by calculating (1) the average KL divergence between the logit distributions of the last l layers and the final layer, capturing internal reasoning consistency, and (2) the entropy of the final token distribution reflecting output uncertainty; normalize both to the unit interval and combine with a learned weighting parameter λ.

modules.name: Adaptive Context Augmentation Controller
modules.description: Implement the incremental context expansion loop: starting from one retrieved chunk, iteratively append the next chunk, invoke the selective recomputation engine and confidence estimator for each augmentation step, and terminate when the confidence score exceeds threshold τ or the maximum number of chunks k is reached; store newly computed KV states into the hard prefix cache for reuse in subsequent iterations of the same query.

modules.name: Corpus Chunking and Embedding Pipeline
modules.description: Process the Wikipedia knowledge base by segmenting documents into fixed-size chunks, encoding each chunk with the e5-base-v2 embedding model, and constructing a FAISS IVF index with the specified number of clusters for efficient approximate nearest neighbor search.

modules.name: RAG Retriever
modules.description: Given a user query, encode it with the same embedding model used for the corpus, perform top-k retrieval against the FAISS index, and return the ranked list of retrieved text chunks; this module executes retrieval once per query and passes the full top-k list to the augmentation controller.

modules.name: RAG Prompt Constructor
modules.description: Assemble the augmented prompt by concatenating the system prompt, the selected retrieved text chunks (up to the current augmentation depth), and the user query; handle tokenization and ensure proper chunk ordering and separator formatting consistent with the LLM's expected input schema.

modules.name: End-to-End RAG Serving Pipeline
modules.description: Orchestrate the complete serving workflow: accept a user query, invoke the retriever for top-k chunks, launch the adaptive context augmentation controller (which internally calls the selective recomputation engine and confidence estimator), execute the LLM prefill phase for each augmentation step, and produce the final decoded answer; manage KV cache transfers between CPU and GPU memory.

modules.name: TTFT Measurement Module
modules.description: Instrument the serving pipeline to record wall-clock latency from request submission to the emission of the first output token; aggregate statistics across batches of queries and report mean, median, and percentile TTFT for each experimental configuration.

modules.name: Exact Match Evaluator
modules.description: Implement the Exact Match metric by normalizing both predicted and reference answer strings and computing the fraction of predictions that exactly match their corresponding references; handle multi-reference answers by accepting a match against any valid reference.

modules.name: Ablation Study Framework
modules.description: Provide controlled experiment configurations that isolate the contributions of cache-aware selective recomputation and adaptive context augmentation; support combinations including Prefix Caching + ACA, CacheBlend + ACA, AdaCache without ACA, and full AdaCache, enabling paired comparison of TTFT and EM across all model and dataset configurations.

modules.name: Context Length Distribution Analyzer
modules.description: Record the termination depth (number of chunks used) selected by adaptive context augmentation for each query, compute histogram statistics, and generate distribution plots across datasets and models to validate the head-heavy context requirement pattern and correlate it with TTFT improvement magnitude.

modules.name: Top-k Sensitivity Experiment Runner
modules.description: Execute the full evaluation pipeline across varying top-k retrieval settings, collect TTFT and EM metrics for each baseline and AdaCache at each k value, and produce comparative plots demonstrating context scalability and performance gap trends as retrieval depth increases.

modules.name: Experiment Configuration and Reporting Suite
modules.description: Manage YAML-based experiment configurations covering model selection, dataset paths, cache hyperparameters (α, β, τ, λ, l), retrieval settings, and hardware specifications; aggregate experimental results into automated LaTeX tables and generate publication-quality figures for TTFT-vs-EM scatter plots, attention heatmaps, and context length distribution charts.
